title: Job
description: One production job (a video or a poster) for one client. Logical record: the storage layer maps it to Google Sheets rows (library/storage/). Source of truth for progress, gates, credits, feedback and outputs.

job_id.description: <CLIENTCODE>-<NN>, e.g. HOL-03. Number comes from client.next_job_number and grows past 99.

style_preset.description: Name of a preset in library/presets/, or null for none.

status.description: Overall job state. Stage-level progress lives in current_stage and stage_history.

waiting_on.description: Who the job is waiting on right now: the owner of the pending gate, or 'none' while a stage is running or the job is closed. Kept in sync by record_gate; drives the status board.

next_action.description: The single next action, one line. Rewritten on every stage or gate change.

stage_history.description: Append-only. Entries are never removed; a reopened stage gets a new entry.

gates.description: Append-only. A reopened or re-shown stage gets a new gate entry.

assignee.description: Team member handle responsible for the job.

urgent.description: Set by the admin at intake (or later). Stages with skippable_if_urgent are skipped and say so.

research_status.description: Copy of outputs.research.data.research_status for the Jobs tab and the dashboard. Null until the research stage runs.

budget.description: Hard cap. Spending beyond it needs an admin-approved budget gate.

warn_at.description: Soft limit: tell the assignee when used + estimate passes it. Null for none.

used.description: Sum of ledger amounts whose currency is credits (or absent). Money spent in USD or INR is listed in the ledger but never counts here.

amount.description: Amount spent (positive) or refunded (negative), in `currency`. Free methods log 0.

provider.description: Who was paid. Absent on older rows, which are Higgsfield credits.

currency.description: credits = Higgsfield credits (counted in credits.used and against the budget). USD/INR = real money (Apify), never counted in credits.used. Absent = credits.

tier.description: draft = cheapest model first; final = approved upgrade (credit policy).

tool.description: Service and model used, e.g. higgsfield/<model>.

approved_by.description: Handle of whoever approved an upgrade or an over-budget spend.

outputs.description: Stage outputs keyed by contract field name (the `writes` names in stages.yaml).

revision_round.description: Client revision rounds used so far; compare with client.revision_cap.

log.description: Most recent events, newest last. The job record keeps only the last 20.

kind.description: ruling = a call made on someone's behalf (what, why, cost if wrong), for the gate owner to review.

version.description: Increments on every save. Used to detect concurrent edits.

kind.description: stage = the stage's own gate; budget = admin approval to spend beyond the job budget; spend = admin approval before a stage spends real money (a stage's spend_gate, e.g. a paid Apify run), asked before running.

shown_outputs.description: Output versions shown for approval, e.g. {"script": 2}. An approval covers only these versions; if an output changes afterwards, the gate is re-requested.

decided_by.description: Handle of the approver; for client gates, the team member who recorded the client's decision.

sent_back_to.description: Stage to reopen when status is sent_back.

version.description: Increments each time the stage rewrites this output.

data.description: Inline structured content, validated against the field's schema when one exists. Placeholder stages write {placeholder: true, note}.

files.description: Links or paths of files produced (Google Drive links in the job's folder).

schema.description: Schema file the data follows, e.g. brief.schema.json.

feedback.description: One client reply (possibly several WhatsApp messages), triaged by client-feedback.

about_version.description: Version of the output the client was looking at. Lower than the current version = feedback on an old version.

from.description: Name or role of the person at the client. Never a phone number.

raw.description: The client's messages exactly as received, minus phone numbers.

quote.description: The client's exact words for this item. Never paraphrased away.

change.description: The concrete change, in team language.

question.description: One short question for the client (clarification items).

duplicate_of.description: Item n in this reply, or '<feedback_id>#<n>' for an earlier one.

resolution.description: Filled once the client or admin decides. Never chosen silently.

over_cap.description: True if this round exceeds client.revision_cap.

messages.description: WhatsApp-ready drafts. Over-cap and change-order messages need admin approval before sending.
